SESSION	create temporary view nt1 as select * from values
SESSION	create temporary view nt2 as select * from values
READ	SELECT * FROM nt1 left outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k FROM nt1 left outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT nt1.*, nt2.* FROM nt1 left outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT nt1.k, nt2.k FROM nt1 left outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k FROM (SELECT nt2.k FROM nt1 left outer join nt2 using (k))
READ	SELECT nt2.k AS key FROM nt1 left outer join nt2 using (k) ORDER BY key
READ	SELECT nt1.k, nt2.k FROM nt1 left outer join nt2 using (k) ORDER BY nt2.k
READ	SELECT k, nt1.k FROM nt1 left outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k, nt2.k FROM nt1 left outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT * FROM nt1 left semi join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k FROM nt1 left semi join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT nt1.* FROM nt1 left semi join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT nt1.k FROM nt1 left semi join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k, nt1.k FROM nt1 left semi join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT * FROM nt1 right outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k FROM nt1 right outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT nt1.*, nt2.* FROM nt1 right outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT nt1.k, nt2.k FROM nt1 right outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k FROM (SELECT nt1.k FROM nt1 right outer join nt2 using (k))
READ	SELECT nt1.k AS key FROM nt1 right outer join nt2 using (k) ORDER BY key
READ	SELECT k, nt1.k FROM nt1 right outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k, nt2.k FROM nt1 right outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT * FROM nt1 full outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k FROM nt1 full outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT nt1.*, nt2.* FROM nt1 full outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT nt1.k, nt2.k FROM nt1 full outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k FROM (SELECT nt2.k FROM nt1 full outer join nt2 using (k))
READ	SELECT nt2.k AS key FROM nt1 full outer join nt2 using (k) ORDER BY key
READ	SELECT k, nt1.k FROM nt1 full outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k, nt2.k FROM nt1 full outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT * FROM nt1 full outer join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k FROM nt1 inner join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT nt1.*, nt2.* FROM nt1 inner join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT nt1.k, nt2.k FROM nt1 inner join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k FROM (SELECT nt2.k FROM nt1 inner join nt2 using (k))
READ	SELECT nt2.k AS key FROM nt1 inner join nt2 using (k) ORDER BY key
READ	SELECT k, nt1.k FROM nt1 inner join nt2 using (k)
READ	SELECT k, nt2.k FROM nt1 inner join nt2 using (k)
